## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and the behavior after this change. Link an issue
or scope decision where relevant.

## Verification

List the checks actually run, their results and the tested environment/revision.
Include browser/device or package evidence when applicable. State any missing
coverage, failures or material risks.

## Review notes

Mention contract/data compatibility, documentation changes and anything requiring
a maintainer decision. Remove this section if there is nothing additional to note.

- [ ] The change is focused and excludes unrelated edits, private data and runtime artifacts.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is current; protocol changes include contracts, examples, regression coverage and an ADR.
- [ ] The full local gate passed, or the limitation is explained above.
- [ ] Acceptance claims match the actual evidence; emulation is not described as physical-device testing.
